title: Martial arts robots dazzle at 2026 Spring Festival Gala #CoolChina #springfestival2026 #kungfu
summary: CGTN coverage of the 2026 Spring Festival Gala, in which humanoid robots perform synchronized martial arts routines alongside children.
why: Cited as a snapshot of Chinese humanoid robot capability, with some commenters doubting its authenticity.

quote.text: They’re incredibly capable (again, save for hands which is a huge mechanical and software problem) and cheap.
